content:wysiwyg_basic:2:75.html:
Each day throughout Metro Atlanta, The Salvation Army Financial Emergency Services Centers provide emergency and life-sustaining assistance with food, clothing, rent/mortgage, utilities, school supplies, and furniture to individuals and families facing a financial crisis.

If you need financial emergency assistance, you may apply online at SAhelp.org. If you are currently facing a personal or financial crisis, call 211* for a list of other Metro Area resources. * 211 Is a toll-free, 24-hour, referral line hosted by the United Way of Metro Atlanta.

The Salvation Army Gwinnett Financial Emergency Assistance Center

Gwinnett County
3455 Sugarloaf Parkway
Lawrenceville, GA 30044
404-486-2888
